stories.title: Governed term premium observed; long‑end decomposition and volatility remain unresolved.
stories.whatChanged: NY Fed ACM shows a governed 10Y term premium with a five‑session decline while nominal 10Y yield remains elevated.
stories.whyItMatters: A governed term premium reduces the need to assign all nominal moves to term‑premium, but without MOVE and full real/breakeven cross‑checks the cause of high yields is unresolved.
stories.mechanism: Nominal yields reflect front‑end policy pricing and elevated real yields; ACM term‑premium is present but does not fully explain nominal levels without volatility/real‑breakeven confirmation.
stories.conclusion: Governed term‑premium evidence is present, but nominal yield attribution among real yield, breakeven and residual remains unresolved pending MOVE and dealer/auction sequencing.
stories.whatWouldChangeMind: Canonical MOVE/Treasury‑volatility series or a clear coordinated move in real yields/breakevens would permit decomposition and change the attribution.

stories.title: Meta’s negative free cash flow and wide AI/semiconductor moves put pressure on concentrated AI leadership.
stories.whatChanged: Meta reported negative simple FCF for Q3 and raised a capex floor; several AI/semiconductor names and SMH fell on 22 Oct.
stories.whyItMatters: Issuer cash‑flow and capex guidance are direct channels from AI investment to financing stress; price weakness in CRWV, SMH and AMD suggests issuer/sector sentiment deterioration.
stories.mechanism: Higher capex and negative FCF raise funding needs and credit sensitivity for AI‑heavy issuers, pressuring their equity and CDS; whether this pushes systemic credit wider is unproven.
stories.conclusion: Meta’s filing shows cash‑flow strain and higher capex guidance, and AI/semiconductor shares fell; resilient large‑cap breadth limits a conclusion that this is broad market stress.
stories.whatWouldChangeMind: Intraday macro timing showing coordinated same‑session yield/gold/USD moves with Meta’s release or widening IG OAS would indicate broader transmission.

investigations.question: Is recent yield repricing transmitting into credit spreads, volatility and equity breadth?
investigations.whyItMatters: If rates pressure broadens into IG, MOVE and breadth, financing conditions tighten materially beyond concentrated tech risk.
investigations.currentExplanation: HY spreads widened substantially over a 20‑session window while IG moved modestly and large‑cap breadth stayed strong; canonical MOVE and intraday timing are missing, so transmission remains unresolved.
investigations.expectedReaction: Conventional: rising real yields/front end should widen credit spreads, lift VIX and weaken broad breadth/small caps.
investigations.observedReaction: HY OAS widened 54 bp (20s); IG OAS +11 bp; large‑cap breadth remains elevated.
competingExplanations: Sector/issuer concentration drives HY widening while broader markets hold.
HY is a leading indicator that will broaden if yields persist.

candidateExplanations.explanation: Issuer/sector concentration in riskier credits caused HY widening while IG and volatility remain contained.
candidateExplanations.discriminatingTest: Canonical MOVE series and daily IG OAS persistence coordinating with HY widening.

candidateExplanations.explanation: HY widening is an early stage of broader stress that will show up in IG and breadth if yields persist.
candidateExplanations.discriminatingTest: IG OAS and MOVE widen in step with sustained HY widening and weakening breadth outside megacaps.

investigations.invalidationCondition: HY widening persistently decouples from IG and MOVE while breadth stays robust.

verified.title: Long-end Treasury stress
verified.detail: On 24 September 2026, the U.S. Treasury par yield curve closed with the 10-year yield at 5.18% and the 30-year yield at 5.47%, confirming severe long-duration rate pressure.

verified.title: S&P concentration remains extreme
verified.detail: Nvidia and Apple together accounted for more than 15% of the S&P 500, reinforcing the concentration risk behind an index that can remain firm even when participation is weaker.

verified.title: Saudi/Houthi energy risk persists
verified.detail: Saudi-led coalition forces said six Houthi ballistic missiles were intercepted on 24 September, with Yanbu among the targeted areas; the report also described claimed attacks on Saudi Aramco facilities in Yanbu.

verified.title: Duration stress is global
verified.detail: A Bloomberg global sovereign-bond yield gauge approached 4%, the highest level since 2007, supporting the view that duration pressure is global rather than solely a U.S. Treasury story.

verified.title: Natural-gas storage tightened
verified.detail: EIA reported Lower-48 working gas at 3,351 Bcf for the week ended 18 September 2026, a 53 Bcf weekly injection and 95 Bcf above the five-year average.

verified.title: NBIS analyst catalyst verified
verified.detail: BNP Paribas upgraded Nebius Group from Neutral to Outperform and raised its price target from $260 to $399 on 24 September 2026, independently confirming a catalyst cited in the StockedUp transcript.

verified.title: US–China tariff cliff pushed out
verified.detail: U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said the U.S. and China agreed to extend their trade truce through 10 January 2027, reducing the immediate tariff-cliff risk while broader negotiations continue.

verified.title: US–Iran diplomacy is active
verified.detail: President Trump said U.S.-Iran talks were continuing during the UN General Assembly and that he believed a settlement would be reached; this verifies active diplomacy but not the transcript's specific Hormuz-for-sanctions terms.

verified.title: Diesel export-policy risk
verified.detail: The U.S. Chamber warned that restricting U.S. diesel or fuel exports could squeeze refiners and risk reducing supplies of diesel, gasoline and jet fuel, potentially worsening consumer costs.

verified.title: Late-September midterm seasonality
verified.detail: Citadel Securities' historical midterm-year path shows equities tending to weaken into around September 30 before a stronger average year-end phase; this supports late-September seasonality as context, not a forecast.

verified.title: META Muse catalyst verified
verified.detail: Meta launched its Muse personal AI agent and said it planned integration with smart glasses, independently confirming the product catalyst behind the creator's META discussion.

verified.title: RKLB defence-space catalyst verified
verified.detail: Rocket Lab said it was selected for the U.S. Space Force NITE-STAR IDIQ program, which has a ceiling of up to $981 million across participating vendors, confirming the defence-space catalyst cited by StockedUp.
